headline: Corn Producers Maintain Road Blockades Despite 950-Peso Federal Incentive
summary: Farmers maintain road blockades despite a 950-peso federal incentive, demanding written operating rules, guarantees, regulated imports and priority purchase of domestic grain.
why: Maize is a staple crop and key feed input in Mexico, and import levels affect domestic farm prices. Disputes over purchase terms can disrupt grain supply chains.
original_headline: Productores de maíz mantienen bloqueos carreteros pese a incentivo federal de 950 pesos
